page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The instance features 32 virtual CPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, offering 1229 GB of temporary disk capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall within the average range. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in image processing and memory-intensive operations, as reflected by its top-25% Passmark memory score. In text generation tasks using small language models, it achieves top-tier performance, though performance drops to the bottom 25% for prompt processing on large 70B models. Other operations, such as Redis SET, static web serving, and database operations, perform at average levels.

The E32ads_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high memory capacity relative to compute resources. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and the inclusion of a 1229 GB local disk reduce the need for external storage attachments for temporary data, optimizing resource density. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, including relational databases, in-memory caches like Redis, data analytics, and medium-scale web serving.
